bank_name: The Jammu and Kashmir State Co-operative Bank Ltd.

website_metadata.notes: The bank's own site jkscbank.com (titled 'J&K STATE COOPERATIVE Bank') appears in search results but is unreachable from here (HTTP 000 / connection timeout on https, http, and www variants). Registry hint domain coopbank.co.in is a third-party banking portal, not the bank. No FD rate page could be retrieved; may work later.

warnings: Do NOT confuse with Jammu & Kashmir Bank (jkb.bank.in), a separate commercial bank — search results repeatedly conflated the two.
Bank contact email is jkscb21000@yahoo.com per district NIC listings, consistent with weak web presence.
